title: Arcana Modifications
description: [WIP]A mod that aims to change certain vanilla or modded aspects that we sometimes wish were part of the base experience.
body:
This mod is in early stages of development. Many things shown here may change.

## Moded Changes
### Create Mod
Added compatibility for the wrench pick up [Create Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/create) with the following mods:
- Caupona
- Chipped
- CreateDeco
- Minecraft
- Neoforge tags
- Quark
- Sophisticated Storage 
- Supplementaries

# Minecraft
## Gameplay Modifications
- Added SPAWN_PHANTOMS_END. A config value set to true by default to make phantoms spawn in the end. Adds new recipe for mending books: a phantom membrane and a book in an anvil.
- Added REWORK_VANILLA_ENCHANTMENTS. Reworks the entire villager trades and way of obtaining some enchanted books.
- When a players joins a world they will unlock all recipes.

## Gamerules
These values are set in the config files. When starting a server, the server will run these gamerules according to the set values.
- Added DO_PATROL_SPAWNING
- Added DO_INSOMNIA

<details>
<summary>REWORK_VANILLA_ENCHANTMENTS</summary>

# Rework Enchanting System

- Added a new config option to toggle this system on/off.

## Loot Table Changes

- Aqua Affinity → Elder Guardian death
- Depth Strider & Respiration → Added to sea ruins
- Thorns → Added to desert temple
- Feather Falling → Anvil crafting with Breeze Rods

---

## Villager Changes

- Cleared all trades from the following professions:

---

### Armorer

The first two trades (Level 1) determine Tier 3–5 armor parts and enchantments.

#### Level 1

**Enchantment Hint Trades**
- Input: Shield → Output: x1 Emeralds (Protection hint)
- Input: Charcoal → Output: x1 Emeralds (Fire Protection hint)
- Input: Coal → Output: x1 Emeralds (Blast Protection hint)

**Group Hint Trades**
- Input: x4 Emerald → Output: x1 Chainmail Helmets (Upper group)
- Input: x4 Emerald → Output: x1 Chainmail Leggings (Lower group)
  - Max Uses: 12 | XP: 10 | Price Multiplier: 0.75

#### Level 2

- Input: 4 Iron Ingots → Output: 1 Emerald
- Input: 36 Emeralds → Output: 1 Bell

#### Level 3–5

- Input: Emeralds + same armor piece → Output: Enchanted armor

**Prices by tier**
- Boots → 9 / 18 / 27 Emeralds
- Helmet → 12 / 24 / 36 Emeralds
- Leggings → 15 / 30 / 45 Emeralds
- Chestplate → 18 / 36 / 54 Emeralds

---

### Fisherman

#### Level 1
**Enchantment Hint Trades**
- Input: x8 Prismarine Shards → Output: Emeralds (Impaling)
- Input: x1 Fishing Rod → Output: x1 Emeralds (Loyalty)
- Input: x4 Prismarine Crystals → Output: x1 Emeralds (Riptide)
- Input: x1 Lightning Rod → Output: x1 Emeralds (Channeling)
- Always: Input: x9 Emeralds → Output: Nautilus Shell
  - Max Uses: 4 | XP: 20 | Price Multiplier: 0.75

#### Level 2
- Input: x13 Salmon → Output: 1 Emerald
- Input: x1 Emerald → Output: 1 Campfire

#### Level 3
- Input: x22 Emeralds + 1 Trident → Output: Enchanted Trident

#### Level 4
- Input: x6 Tropical Fish → Output: Emeralds
- Input: x12 String → Output: Emeralds

#### Level 5
- Input: x8 Emeralds + 1 Fishing Rod → Output: Fishing Rod (Luck of the Sea III)

---

### Fletcher

- Groups:
  - 45% Bow  (Bow for emeralds)
  - 45% Crossbow  (Crossbow for emeralds)
  - 10% Master: Input: x7 Wheat + x2 White Wool → Output: x1 Target

**Enchantment Hint Trades**
- Input: x4 Slime Ball → Output: Emeralds (Punch)
- Input: x3 Fire Charge → Output: Emeralds (Flame)
- Input: x1 Echo Shard → Output: Emeralds (Infinity)
- Input: x5 Quartz → Output: Emeralds (Power)
- Input: x12 Sugar → Output: Emeralds (Quick Charge)
- Input: x5 Arrows → Output: Emeralds (Multishot)
- Input: x4 Iron → Output: Emeralds (Piercing)
  - Max Uses: 12 | XP: 10

#### Level 2
- Input: x32 Sticks → Output: x1 Emerald
- Input: x26 Flint → Output: x1 Emerald
  - Max Uses: 16 | XP: 5

#### Level 3
- Input: Emeralds + Bow/Crossbow → Output: Enchanted Bow/Crossbow
- Input: x20 String → Output: Emerald
- Input: x1 Flint + x2 Stick → Output: x3 Arrow

#### Level 4
- Input: x2 Tripwire Hook → Output: x5 Emeralds
- Input: x1 Emerald → Output: x4 Arrows
  - Max Uses: 12 | XP: 15

#### Level 5
- Input: x8 Emeralds + x5 Arrows → Output: x5 Spectral Arrows
- Input: x12 Emeralds + x5 Arrows → Output: x5 Tipped Arrows (Poison / Luck / Slowness)

---

### Librarian

> The only enchanted book that can be obtained from this villager profession will be Unbreaking II or Unbreaking III, always in the final tier.

#### Level 1
- Input: x24 Paper → Output: x1 Emeralds
- Input: x4 Emeralds → Output: x1 Bookshelf

#### Level 2
- Input: x1 Emerald → Output: x9 Books
- Input: x3 Emeralds → Output: x3 Lanterns

#### Level 3
- Input: x5 Ink Sac → Output: x1 Emerald
- Input: x1 Emerald → Output: x4 Glass

#### Level 4
- Input: x4 Emeralds → Output: x1 Writable Book
- Input: x5 Emeralds → Output: Clock
- Input: x4 Emeralds → Output: Compass

#### Level 5
- Input: x20 Emeralds + x1 Book → Output: x1 Enchanted Book

---

### Toolsmith

**Tool Groups**
- Depending on the randomly selected group, the tools that the villager will enchant will vary.
  - A (Coal): STONE_PICKAXE, STONE_HOE, IRON_PICKAXE, IRON_HOE, DIAMOND_PICKAXE, DIAMOND_HOE
  - B (Charcoal): WOODEN_PICKAXE, WOODEN_HOE, GOLDEN_PICKAXE, GOLDEN_HOE
  - C (Flint): STONE_AXE, STONE_SHOVEL, IRON_AXE, IRON_SHOVEL, DIAMOND_AXE, DIAMOND_SHOVEL
  - D (Diamond): WOODEN_AXE, WOODEN_SHOVEL, GOLDEN_AXE, GOLDEN_SHOVEL

**Enchantment Hint Trades**
- Input: x32 Iron Nuggets → Output: x1 Emeralds (Efficiency)
- Input: x12 String → Output: x1 Emeralds (Silk Touch)
- Input: x4 Iron Ingots → Output: x1 Emeralds (Fortune)
  - Max Uses: 12 | XP: 10

#### Level 2
- Input: Sticks → Output: Emerald

#### Level 3–5
- Input: Emeralds + Tool → Output: Enchanted Tool

**Price scaling**
- Hoe → lowest
- Shovel/Axe → medium
- Pickaxe → highest

**Exception**
- If the groups are B or D, the Level 4 trade will be:
  - Input: x36 Emeralds → Output: x1 Bell

---

### Weaponsmith

- Groups: axe or sword.

**Enchantment Hint Trades**
- Input: x4 Charcoal → Output: x1 Emeralds (Fire Aspect)
- Input: x4 Coal → Output: x1 Emeralds (Smite)
- Input: x36 Emeralds → Output: x1 Bell (Knockback hint)
- Input: x1 Diamond → Output: x1 Emeralds (Looting)
- Input: x3 Quartz → Output: x1 Emeralds (Sharpness)
- Input: x3 Amethyst → Output: x1 Emeralds (Sweeping Edge)

#### Level 2–5
- Input: Emeralds + Weapon → Output: Enchanted Weapon

**Special Rule**
- Sweeping Edge:
  - Sword → applied normally
  - Axe → replaced with Unbreaking III

---

> **Note:** Mending cannot be obtained through this system. Review other options in the mod to obtain it.
